name: Magali Botanical Hair Oil
shortDescription: A nutrient-rich botanical hair oil with 14 herbal botanicals and three natural oils to nourish the scalp, support stronger-looking hair, and add natural shine.
overview: Magali Botanical Hair Oil blends 14 botanical infusions with olive, castor, and coconut oils in a formula made for everyday scalp and strand care. Suitable for all hair textures, including natural, color-treated, and chemically processed hair.
benefits: Nourishes the scalp and hair roots
Supports stronger-looking hair and reduced breakage
Helps smooth frizz and improve manageability
Suitable for all hair types and textures
directions: Apply a small amount directly to the scalp and hair.
Massage gently into the scalp for 3 to 5 minutes.
Leave in as a daily treatment or wash out with shampoo if preferred.
Use 3 to 4 times per week for best results.
caution: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. Discontinue use if irritation occurs. Keep out of reach of children.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

name: Magali PureHeal Oil
shortDescription: A concentrated blend of cold-pressed castor oil and pure clove essential oil in a precise dropper format for targeted external application.
overview: Magali PureHeal Oil pairs cold-pressed castor oil with pure clove essential oil in a 60 ml amber dropper bottle. The lightweight formula is designed for targeted topical use on dry or irritated skin and for massage into areas of everyday muscle or joint stiffness. For external use only.
benefits: Helps soothe and moisturize dry, rough, or irritated skin
Provides a warming botanical sensation from clove essential oil
Convenient dropper format for targeted application
Can be massaged into areas of everyday muscle or joint stiffness
directions: Dispense a few drops onto clean fingertips or a cotton swab.
Apply directly to the external target area.
Use 2 to 3 times daily or as needed.
caution: For external use only. Avoid direct contact with eyes. Keep out of reach of children. Discontinue use if irritation occurs.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

name: Magali Herbal Hair Grease
shortDescription: A rich herbal hair grease with traditional herbs, natural oils, and shea butter to nourish the scalp, add shine, and improve manageability.
overview: Magali Herbal Hair Grease combines herbs, natural oils, and shea butter in a rich, everyday formula. It supports scalp nourishment, stronger-looking hair, natural shine, and soft, manageable strands for all hair types.
benefits: Helps hair feel soft and manageable
directions: Take a small amount and apply evenly to scalp and hair.
Use 1 to 3 times a week for best results.
caution: For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes. If irritation occurs, discontinue use. Keep out of reach of children.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight.

name: Magali Caribbean Style Beef Pies, 8 Pack
shortDescription: A family-size 8 pack of frozen Caribbean-style beef pies with flaky pastry and a savory seasoned ground beef filling.
overview: Magali Caribbean Style Beef Pies bring bold island flavor to your table in a convenient frozen 8 pack. Each pie features a golden, flaky crust and a seasoned ground beef filling. Cook from frozen in the oven, air fryer, or skillet.
benefits: Oven, air fryer, or skillet preparation
Keep frozen until ready to cook

directions.oven: Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Place frozen pies on a parchment-lined baking tray. Bake 25 to 30 minutes, flipping halfway through, until golden brown and fully heated.
directions.airFryer: Preheat air fryer to 350°F (175°C). Place pies in a single layer and cook 15 to 18 minutes, flipping halfway through, until crispy and heated through.
directions.skillet: Heat 2 to 3 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium heat. Place frozen pies in hot oil and cook 6 to 8 minutes per side until golden and fully cooked.

caution: Always ensure pies reach an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C) before serving. Cooking times may vary depending on your oven, air fryer, or stove.
